extName.message: For My Privacy: Site Password Lock

extDescription.message: Lock chosen sites and all their subdomains behind a password. It locks again when you step away.

tooManyAttempts.message: Too many attempts. Try again in $1.

unlockedNoReturn.message: Unlocked. You can open your site again.

setupHint.message: Use at least 8 characters. It cannot be recovered; if you forget it, reinstall the extension.

domainsHint.message: Each site also locks all of its subdomains.

invalidDomain.message: Enter a site address such as example.com.

permissionDenied.message: Chrome did not allow access to this site, so it was not added.

idleMinutesLabel.message: Minutes without keyboard or mouse input

guardLabel.message: Ask for the password before Chrome's extensions page opens

guardHint.message: Removing the extension from the toolbar menu cannot be blocked. See the README.

permissionLostBody.message: Locked sites stay blocked, but the lock screen cannot open for them. Grant access again.
